Author: NogitsuneGurl
Description:
[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/d0faf285-ad79-4087-9dab-4501f0638490_bge-04-v5-kitsuwick.gif[/img]

[size=6][b][color=#d7b2ff]🦋 Fairy Sorceress 🦋[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][i]petal roofs, enchanted wood and little crystal lights… a home for the grand high fairy sorceress ✨[/i][/size][/center]

Hi hi! 💜 I made you a magical fairy home with [b]65 furnishing and decor designs[/b], plus [b]2 wallpapers and 2 floors[/b]. Cozy petal furniture, warm carved wood, wisteria, spellbooks and crystals, indoors and out. Find the new items and patterns at [b]Robin's[/b] 🪵🦋 The nursery crib is a skin for the game's existing crib.

[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/12c9d589-133e-44a3-be67-e0b68ac31561_fc2a5984ca2e5276-compatible.gif[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]🧺 What's inside[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]🛏️ A real double bed, comfy usable seats, table surfaces, dressers and a winged vanity.[/*]
[*]🔮 Magical lighting, a floating grimoire, crystal displays, mirrors, rugs, shelves and little tabletop pieces.[/*]
[*]🍵 A Sagewood Prep Island and Moonpetal China Cupboard to furnish your kitchen.[/*]
[*]📺 [b]Crystalvision TV:[/b] the game's television channels appear like a hologram between floating crystals. The crystals softly pulse while the TV is on.[/*]
[*]🌸 A [b]Petalnest nursery crib skin[/b], with the native mattress, baby anchors and crib interactions preserved.[/*]
[*]🌳 A [b]Twilight Willow[/b] that switches your local view to enchanted bioluminescent twilight when clicked. Violet willow light, blue Mooncap glow and magenta Rosecap glow make this spell look different from ordinary night. Fairy flowers, crystals and mushroom caps shine. Click again to restore the normal view.[/*]
[*]🍄 Two sister mushroom circles: one moon-blue and one rose-pink. Place one of each with clear arrival space, then step into a circle to travel to its sister.[/*]

[size=4][b]🍵 Optional: Farmhouse Kitchen Reskin[/b][/size]
Dress the built-in stove, sink and cabinets in rosewood, sage enamel and petal details after the first farmhouse upgrade. The vanilla cooking menu still works and the built-in fridge keeps its original appearance. The reskin works on its own or with either furniture edition. Use one kitchen reskin at a time.

[size=4][b]📦 Updating an existing save?[/b][/size]
[b]If you use the original Moonmilk Icebox, Hearthleaf Cooking Stove or Dewpetal Washbasin, keep both original appliance folders or install Legacy Placeable Appliances before opening your save.[/b] Keep one copy of each folder. Back up your save before updating.

[size=4][b]🏡 Optional: Fairy Sorceress House[/b][/size]
A petal-roofed fairy home with butterfly glass, carved wooden framing, sage shutters and a little cauldron-and-potion alcove. [b]The decor works without the house.[/b] Find it under [b]Optional files[/b].
[list]
[*]One final exterior for [b]farmhouse upgrades 2 and 3[/b] (the nursery upgrade and the cellar upgrade). The earlier exteriors stay vanilla.[/*]
[*]The native door, porch, stairs and collision stay aligned. Window and crystal lights follow the house when moved and respond to the Twilight Willow.[/*]
[*]Robin's paint areas cover the wall accents, petal roof and wooden structure. The magical petal roof stays evergreen in all seasons; this file has no separate snowy exterior.[/*]
[*]Install [b]both included house folders[/b]. Set [b]NightWindows[/b] to false in the House Lights folder's config.json to turn off its window and crystal glow.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]🛠️ Requirements & install[/b][/size]
For [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] with [b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b] and [b]Content Patcher 2.9.1+[/b]. Choose [b]one main file[/b]. The Furniture Framework version also needs [b]Furniture Framework 3.3+[/b]. Both main versions include their required television, garden and nursery support.
[spoiler][list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and the frameworks for your chosen main file.[/*]
[*]Download [b]Content Patcher OR Furniture Framework[/b], then extract [b]every included mod folder[/b] into your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Keep the included support folders. They provide the television and garden functions.[/*]
[*]Want the matching kitchen or house exterior? Choose either or both under [b]Optional files[/b]. Install both included folders for the house.[/*]
[*]Start through SMAPI and visit [b]Robin's[/b] 🪵💜[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]❓ Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The willow changes the [b]local visual lighting only[/b]. It does not advance time or change weather, crops or NPC schedules. Removing the active tree or reloading restores the normal view.[/*]
[*]Use exactly one blue and one pink circle for a pair. Duplicate, missing or blocked endpoints will not send you into an unsafe landing. Leave the centers and arrival areas clear.[/*]
[*]Furniture Framework adds the declared colored lights, animations and display slots. Content Patcher keeps native furniture behavior; its ordinary automatic lamps and presentation can differ. The garden magic and native TV have their own included support in both versions.[/*]
[*]Keep your chosen main-file type on an existing save. Content Patcher and Furniture Framework use different furniture IDs; switching between them is not an update path.[/*]
[*]The Legacy Placeable Appliances download keeps the separate cooking stove, refill sink and mini-fridge. The optional kitchen reskin applies to the fixed farmhouse fixtures.[/*]
[*]Mirrors are painted glass, not live reflections. Display cupboards and decorative drawer fronts do not open into storage. The native crib skin can conflict with other mods editing the same nursery tiles.[/*]
[*]Use one farmhouse retexture at a time. Custom maps and multiplayer are not covered by this release's checks.[/*]
[*]The gallery uses [b]actual game screenshots[/b] and labelled panels assembled in [b]Kitsuwick[/b]. The farm and rooms are base-game backdrops; the catalog includes the three appliances now in the legacy download and shows animated pieces as stills.[/*]
[*]Before uninstalling, clear storage and remove custom placed items from your save.[/*]
[/list][b]💌 Sharing:[/b] Enjoy it in your game, screenshots and streams! Please don't reupload, sell or bundle the set, and ask me before sharing edits or reusing the art 🙏
